options.systemMessage: You are a service orchestrator for a multi-tenant platform. You receive tenant requests that specify which services are needed. For each service listed in the request, call the corresponding tool using the tenant_config, event_type and payload provided. Call all listed services in the order listed. After calling all tools, return only a JSON object with the results. Do not explain. Do not narrate.

parameters.content:
### TENANT A — E-commerce SMB
### New Order (email only)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"new_order","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":120.00}}'

###  Cart Abandoned (email only)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"cart_abandoned","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":89.99}}'

###  Refund Requested (email only)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_a","event_type":"refund_requested","payload":{"customer_email":"anna@shop.com","cart_value":45.00}}'

### TENANT B — B2B SaaS
### Trial Signup (email + CRM)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"trial_signup","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","plan":"trial"}}'

### Upgrade (email + CRM)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"upgrade","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","plan":"pro"}}'

### Churn Signal (email + CRM)
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_b","event_type":"churn_signal","payload":{"customer_email":"john@acme.com","company":"Acme Corp","usage_drop":"78%"}}'

### TENANT C — Healthcare Provider (PII masking + email)
###  Appointment Reminder — includes PII fields to verify masking
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_c","event_type":"appointment_reminder","payload":{"customer_email":"patient@clinic.com","patient_name":"Jane Smith","dob":"1985-03-22","phone":"555-0100"}}'

###  Intake Completed — includes PII fields to verify masking
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/oem-event-router-v3 \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_c","event_type":"intake_completed","payload":{"customer_email":"patient@clinic.com","patient_name":"John Doe","dob":"1990-07-15","phone":"555-0200"}}'
